summary: The Test stage runs both components' local test verbs in containerTemplates.iac_toolchain after the clone and before either kaniko stage, so a red suite publishes nothing (V05, V06, V08). One advisory: the container comment names helm as a suite dependency, and neither suite runs it.

findings.summary: Jenkinsfile:18-20 says the suites shell out to helm; no test in either suite invokes helm
